newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv sets convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv sets convertible bond.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd has placed a US$130 million convertible bond issue, joint lead manager Jardine Fleming said on Wednesday.
Credit Lyonnais was the other joint lead.
The issue, which initially was intended to be US$110 million, was raised to US$130 million by means of a US$20 million greenshoe.

The Euroconvertible issue pays an annual coupon of one percent and allows investors to convert the bonds into ordinary shares of the company at HK$13.75 at any time during the five-year life of the issue.

The conversion price represents a 25.45 percent premium over the average closing share price over the last five days, which Jardine Fleming said was a record premium for recent convertible bond issues in Hong Kong.
The global bond issue was eight times oversubscribed, Jardine Fleming said.
